name: How long does it take to replace windows in a typical home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace windows in a typical home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window replacement varies based on the number of windows, their size, the type of installation, and any unforeseen structural issues. For a typical home with 10-15 windows, the installation process usually takes 1 to 3 days. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption, and we provide a clear timeline during the initial consultation. Complex projects or homes with a large number of windows may require more time, and we'll communicate that estimate upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing windows in a typical home with 10-15 windows usually takes 1 to 3 days, depending on project complexity.
